plan.name: Systematic Search and Disposal
plan.strategy: Systematically search all likely storage locations for a cool apple before disposal.
steps: Check the fridge 1 for a cool apple.
If not found, check cabinet 1 through cabinet 9 in order.
If still not found, check drawer 1 through drawer 13 in order.
Once a cool apple is located, take it and move to the garbagecan 1.
Place the cool apple in the garbagecan 1.
